picks.angle: A model that beats last year's GPT-4 runs on a cheap laptop. Lead with the 8GB number.

story.title: A 3B open model now beats last year's GPT-4 on coding benchmarks
story.summary: The model runs on a laptop with 8GB of RAM. Weights are Apache 2.0. Benchmarks show it ahead on HumanEval and within a point on MBPP.

picks.angle: AI in the keyboard means it's in every app at once. The 'no copy-paste' detail is the hook.

story.title: Google puts Gemini inside Android's keyboard for every app
story.summary: Gboard now rewrites, summarizes and translates text in any app without copy-paste. Free on Pixel first, other Android phones over the next month.

picks.angle: An AI that interrupts itself to fix a mistake is a weird, human detail. Good closer.

story.title: OpenAI ships a voice mode that can interrupt itself mid-sentence
story.summary: The update lets the assistant stop talking when it realizes it was wrong and correct course, without the user cutting in. Rolling out to paid tiers this week.
